title: 市值5万亿的苹果：反而去借70亿，廉价资金压低资本成本？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Apple planning to raise about $7 billion from its first investment grade bond offering in more than a year to help fund share buybacks.
segments.zh: 苹果计划通过一年多来首次**级债券发行筹集约70亿美元，用于资助权益资产回购。

segments.en: Bloomberg intelligence analyst Robert Schiffman writes that Apple's return to the bond market appears more opportunistic than a funding driven he joins us now.
segments.zh: 彭博情报分析师罗伯特·希夫曼写道，苹果重返债券市场似乎更多是机会主义行为，而非融资驱动。他现在加入我们。

segments.en: Let's start there and then get to the bigger context of what's happening in markets today. Why is this opportunistic for Apple?
segments.zh: 让我们从这里开始，然后讨论今天市场的更大背景。为什么这对苹果来说是机会主义的？

segments.en: Well, listen, I think Apple has to be in consideration once again for the tech code status.
segments.zh: 嗯，听着，我认为苹果必须再次考虑科技代码地位。

segments.en: It's at all times stock highs, kind of $5 trillion market cap, triple A ratings and bond spreads tighter than peers.
segments.zh: 它始终处于权益资产高点，市值约5万亿美元，拥有3A评级，债券利差比同行更紧。

segments.en: You know, so why borrow? It's cheap money. This is, remember, this is not a neocloud at 17 percent yield.
segments.zh: 你知道，那为什么要借钱？这是廉价资金。记住，这不是17%收益率的 neo cloud。

segments.en: They're going to borrow 10 year money in the belly of the curve in around five and a half percent.
segments.zh: 他们将在曲线腹部借入10年期资金，利率约为5.5%。

segments.en: It's a real opportunity, particularly with Treasuries rallying to lower their weighted average cost of capital by that stock, help shareholders and do it without damaging bondholders.
segments.zh: 这是一个真正的机会，尤其是随着国债上涨，通过该权益资产降低加权平均资本成本，帮助股东，同时不损害债券持有人。

segments.en: Yeah, okay, listen, this is a flight to quality tight market. And this is as quality as you can get. You know, Apple is probably the new unicorn, right?
segments.zh: 是的，好的，听着，这是一个追求质量的紧缩市场。而这已经是最优质的了。你知道，苹果可能是新的独角兽，对吧？

segments.en: If you look at this whole hyperscaler space, everyone is bleeding cash. They're all looking to raise money.
segments.zh: 纵观整个超大规模云服务领域，大家都在消耗现金，都在寻求融资。

segments.en: You know, we think Apple is going to generate 150 billion of free cash in fiscal 2027.
segments.zh: 我们认为苹果在2027财年将产生1500亿美元的自由现金流。

segments.en: So what do they need to do with it? You know, I don't think there's big M&A out there.
segments.zh: 那他们需要做什么？我认为目前没有大型并购机会。
